response.justification: Bogdan has deep technical expertise, extensive open-source contributions, and strong leadership in project development and mentoring, but lacks demonstrated experience in IT architecture design, UML modeling, and client-facing advisory roles, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical gap given the C1 requirement.
strengths: Proven track record in open-source leadership with GISCollective and multiple DLang libraries
Broad full-stack experience across languages, platforms, and DevOps tooling
Strong mentorship and workshop background in TDD, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, falling far short of required C1 level
No explicit evidence of UML, IT architecture design, or requirements management experience
Lacks documented experience in technical leadership of client projects or consulting advisory roles
